goal: Prevent nodes from self-advertising proxy exit IPs like Tor exit nodes on outbound connections
Stop unreachable proxy addresses from polluting network address tables and causing failed connections
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept approval because nodes should not advertise addresses they cannot be reached on (0xB10C, naiyoma)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents proxy users from gossiping unreachable exit IPs across the network
Significantly reduces address manager pollution that currently triggers frequent failed connection attempts
